# The metrics cannot be read. The diagnostics would be a partial report, so the script exits with 3 and the desk hands the case to a person without a call to the analyst.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec beehavereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

grep 'HANDOFF: the diagnostics could not be read \(rc 3\)' home/.incident/incidents/incident-2/timeline.tsv
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 commander$' pages.log
! exists calls.log
! exists writes.log

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"d1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"ROLLBACK error rate 40 percent"}
-- home/.incident/config --
OPS_API=http://ops.test
SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.incident/spool
INC_POLL=1
INC_MINUTE=1
INC_TICK=1
-- home/.incident/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_services_checkout_metrics.fail --
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --

-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
